Kya tum ne us shakhs ko dekha hai jo Qiyaamat ko jhutlaata hai
Ye wahi hai jo yateem ko dhakke deta hai
Aur kisi ko miskeen ke khaane ke liye tayyaar nahin karta hai
To tabaahi hai un namaaziyon ke liye
Jo apni namaazon se ghaafil rehte hain
Dikhaane ke liye amal karte hain
Aur maamooli zuroof bhi aariyat par dene se inkaar kar dete hain
